(async()=>{const d=window.__magicPencil,c=document.querySelector('canvas[data-mesh-count]');if(!d||!c||!window.MediaRecorder)throw Error('Recording unavailable');d.pause();d.setSpeed(1);d.seek(0.151);const stream=c.captureStream(30);const recorder=new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:'video/webm;codecs=vp9',videoBitsPerSecond:6000000});const chunks=[];recorder.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data)};const finished=new Promise(resolve=>{recorder.onstop=async()=>{const blob=new Blob(chunks,{type:recorder.mimeType});window.__pencilVideo=await new Promise(done=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>done(reader.result);reader.readAsDataURL(blob)});stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());resolve({bytes:blob.size,mime:recorder.mimeType})}});recorder.start();d.play();await new Promise(resolve=>{function frame(){if(d.getStatus().progress>=0.66){d.pause();resolve()}else requestAnimationFrame(frame)}requestAnimationFrame(frame)});recorder.stop();return await finished})()
